falsifier: Reject the mechanism if fewer than four of six chronological folds show the preregistered positive trend-high-persistence and reversal-low-persistence IC interaction, or funding fails to reduce net carry paid in at least four folds. Reject economically if fewer than four folds are profitable after base costs, required regime or sleeve signs or doubled-cost viability fail, or fewer than 70 percent of declared neighbors are profitable; no aggregate metric compensates.
thesis: When the causal common-market path and breadth are coherent, slow information diffusion produces residual continuation; when they are inefficient and fragmented, temporary liquidity imbalances produce residual reversal. Realized funding identifies crowded expensive positioning, while both sleeves remain active under a bounded causal direction tilt.
